newsitem.title: USA: Westinghouse to buy two Gaylord cable units.
newsitem.headline: Westinghouse to buy two Gaylord cable units.

text.p: Westinghouse Electric Corp and Gaylord Entertainment Co said Monday they have signed a definitive agreement in which Westinghouse would acquire, by merger, Gaylord Entertainment Co's two major cable networks -- TNN, The Nashville Network, and CMT, Country Music Television.
The acquisition would include domestic and international operations of TNN, the U.S. and Canadian operations of CMT and approximately $50 million of working capital, the two companies said.
The deal is subject to several conditions, including regulatory approvals, the receipt of a ruling from the U.S. Internal Revenue Service, and the approval of Gaylord shareholders, they said.
TNN is the second largest North American network and the eighth largest in the U.S., currently reaching over 70 million households in the U.S. CMT has nearly 38 million subscribers in the U.S.
Other assets included in the merger are CMT Canada, a joint venture with Shaw Cable of Canada, several cable production companies, and NASCAR Thunder, a chain of NASCAR- themed retail stores.
